name: watchdog

parameters.query:
SELECT e.workflow_id, e.workflow_name, e.severity, h.last_success_at,
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - h.last_success_at))/60 AS silent_min,
  'absent_heartbeat' AS reason
FROM wf_expectation e
LEFT JOIN wf_heartbeat h ON h.workflow_id = e.workflow_id
WHERE e.enabled
  AND (h.last_success_at IS NULL
       OR now() - h.last_success_at > make_interval(mins => e.expected_every_min + e.grace_min));

SELECT run_id, workflow_id, execution_id, started_at,
  'open_run_stuck' AS reason
FROM wf_run
WHERE status = 'running'
  AND started_at < now() - interval '3 minutes';

SELECT run_id, workflow_id, attempt, finished_at,
  'silent_replay' AS reason
FROM wf_run
WHERE attempt > 1
  AND finished_at > now() - interval '1 hour';

INSERT INTO wf_alert (alert_key)
VALUES ('{{ $json.alert_key }}')
ON CONFLICT (alert_key) DO UPDATE SET last_sent = now(), resolved_at = NULL
  WHERE wf_alert.last_sent < now() - interval '30 minutes'
RETURNING alert_key, first_seen;

UPDATE wf_alert SET resolved_at = now()
WHERE alert_key = '{{ $json.alert_key }}'
  AND resolved_at IS NULL
RETURNING alert_key, first_seen, last_sent, resolved_at;
